gloss: causative: make or let someone do
note: せる/させる 助動詞 only; lexicalised causatives (行かす, 食べさす) are single verb tokens and are not matched.

gloss: causative-passive: be made to do (u-verbs contracted 〜される)

gloss: plain volitional: let's, I'll (u-verbs 〜おう)
note: the volitional is folded into the verb token (行こう/行く) and 'surface ends in う' is not expressible, so this enumerates volitional surfaces seen in the corpus plus common verbs (exact surface + 動詞 POS: precision is exact, recall is limited to the list). 〜ようとする / 〜ようと思う are longer and win where they apply. ましょう is N5.

gloss: intend to do, thinking of doing (ようと思っている)
note: volitional verb + と + 思う; the verb token is painted because the volitional lives inside it (same enumerated surface list as 〜よう). Plain V+と思う is 〜と思う.

gloss: be about to do; try/attempt to do
note: volitional verb + と + する (enumerated volitional surfaces, see 〜よう). Plain V+とする (やるとしたら) is deliberately not matched.

gloss: plain imperative: do! (u-verbs 〜え)
note: imperative is folded into the verb token. Enumerates ichidan 〜ろ imperatives seen in the corpus plus common ones, しろ and 来い. u-verb 〜え imperatives (行け, 待て) share their surface with the 仮定形 before ば and are NOT matched.

gloss: negative imperative: don't (dictionary form + な)
note: 終助詞 な after a dictionary-form verb (ctx) or its contracted ん-form (enumerated surfaces: 'ends in ん' is not expressible). PRECISION WORRY: the exclamatory な after stative verbs (あるな, できるな, 違うな, いるな, 思うな) fires too (~15% of hits); no negative-lemma constraint exists to exclude them.

gloss: polite command: do (parent/teacher tone)
note: なさい after a verb stem (ctx) — ごめんなさい (名詞 + なさい) excluded; おやすみなさい is one token. Second alternative: the clipped 連用形 + な soft command (逃げな, しな) — a 終助詞 な after a NON-dictionary-form verb; the dictionary-form case is more specific and goes to 〜な（禁止）.

gloss: conditional: if (hypothetical/general truth)
note: plus the contracted なけりゃ; other りゃ/きゃ contractions (すりゃ, 行きゃ) are folded into the verb token. なきゃ is claimed by 〜なければならない.

gloss: conditional: if/when; after doing; discovery (〜たら〜た)
note: たら/だら pinned by surface (lemma た/だ).

gloss: conditional: whenever, natural consequence (押すと開く)

gloss: without doing (literary continuative 〜ず)

casual Tokyo tag inviting agreement — 'right?', 'see?', 'isn't it' (the spoken heir of じゃない)
rough emphatic ending, mostly male: 'I'm telling you', 'watch out' (行くぞ, 起きるぞ)
swaggering male ending: 'let's ~', 'I tell you' — friendly bravado
sentence-final もん (from もの): 'because…, after all', a slightly childish or coy justification (だって寒いもん)
old-fashioned or fatherly question tags: かい (yes/no), だい (wh-question) — 行くかい, 何だい
checking a hazy memory — 'was it…?', 'what was it again?' (何でしたっけ, 誰だっけ)
'I wonder…' — soft, mostly women's or older speech (elsewhere かな)
sentence-final の with no だ after it: a soft question (行くの？) or a soft, explaining statement (行くの) — casual, often women's or children's speech
emphatic 'of course!' tacked onto a verb or adjective: 行くとも, いいとも
'I'm TELLING you' / 'I already said' — snapped back, a clipped と言っているの
'or rather…', 'well, more like…' — the self-correcting / hedging tag (っていうか, っつうか, ちゅうか)
fiction's old-man endings: わい for よ/な, のう for なあ, ぞい for ぞ — the grandfather voice
western-Japan flavoured explaining ending, where standard speech has のよ/んだよ (ええんよ)
Kansai sentence ending that asserts or explains — the Kansai んだ (そうやねん, 知らんねん)
Kansai tag: 'right?', 'you know it is' — like Tokyo じゃん (あるやん, やんか, やんけ)
Kansai だ: 'is' (見とくだけや); past やった = だった
note: 〜やん takes や+ん first

gloss: Kansai だろう: 'I bet', 'right?' (そうやろ)
Kansai sentence-final で: 'you know', 'I'm telling you' (行くで, やばいで)
eastern/rustic ending for だろう / let's — 'probably', 'shall we' (行くべ, いけるべ)
rough male speech flattens the negative ない to ねえ: 知らねえ = 知らない, 関係ねえ = 関係ない, じゃねえ = じゃない
Kansai negative ending in place of ない: 行かへん = 行かない, 食べれへん = 食べられない
western-Japan / gruff squeeze of 〜ている: 何やっとる = 何をやっている, なっとる = なっている
〜ている said humbly (しております) or in western / old-fashioned speech (知っておる)
clipped casual です/ます — young, sporty-polite (マジっす, そうなんす)
note: bare す only after ん / a noun-ish word, so the elongated ます of お願いしまーす stays 〜ます

gloss: squashed でしょ: 'right?', 'obviously' (行くっしょ)
very casual squeeze of という / と言う: 終わりだっつった = 終わりだと言った; ちゅう in the west
Kansai squeeze of 〜てやろう: 見せたろか = 見せてやろうか 'shall I show you, then' — often mock-threatening
blunt spoken 'don't you dare' snapped onto a plain verb: 笑うんじゃない, ふざけんじゃねえ
old-fashioned order from someone who outranks you (a boss, a teacher): 読みたまえ, 待ちたまえ
doing it for — or to — someone from above: kindly, condescending, or defiant (教えてやる 'I'll let you in on it', ぶっ殺してやる)
verb + やがる: contempt or exasperation at whoever did it — 'the bastard went and…' (つるんでやがる); かかってきやがれ is its command form
'I'll do it and you'll see' — a declaration of resolve (必ず探し出してみせる); also literally 'show by doing'
humble 〜てくる / 〜ていく: 出てまいりました, 行ってまいります — the polite narrator's / servant's voice
respectful 〜ている: an esteemed person is doing / is (困っていらっしゃる); squeezed to てらっしゃる in speech
stiff or rough 'if not / must': 稼がねば = 稼がなければ(ならない), 捜さにゃならん = 捜さなければならない
Kansai 'have to': ならなあかん = ならなければいけない
blunt or western 'if you don't…' / 'gotta…': 行かんと = 行かないと
'even by doing X' — naming the extreme means you'd stoop to (手荒なことをしてでも)
old, warm 'please do…' (Edo / older women): 許しておくれ = 許してくれ
'can't keep doing this / can't stand to go on' (見ていられない; spoken 見てらんない)
plain verb + がいい: cold permission, 'go ahead then, suit yourself' (好きにするがいい)
め stuck onto a noun to spit at it: バカめ 'you idiot', 時計め 'that damn clock'
plural with contempt: クソども 'you lot', 悪党ども; humble on oneself (私ども)
plural markers for people: 俺たち, 子供たち; ら is rougher or news-style (奴ら, 署員ら)
the name suffixes: さん neutral-polite, ちゃん affectionate, くん/君 to juniors or boys, 様/さま very polite, 殿 formal-old, 氏 news-style
noun + 的 makes an adjective '-ish / -like / -al': 本能的 instinctive, 個人的 personal
noun + 化: turning into, -ization (巨大化, 相対化する)
noun + 性: the quality of, -ness (閉鎖性, 可能性)
noun + 系: of that type / lineage / vibe (破壊系, 癒し系)
noun + 用: for the use of (自転車用, 子供用)
noun + 同士: among/between each other of the same kind (家同士, 友達同士)
noun + ごと: together with the whole thing (体ごと 'body and all', 皮ごと 'skin and all')
time + 過ぎ: just past (6時過ぎ 'a little after six', 30過ぎ 'past thirty')
counter for people: ３人, 何人 (ひとり・ふたり for one and two)
the native counter for things: 一つ, 二つ … 九つ; also 'years old' for children
counter for small objects: 3個
counter for flat things (paper, plates, shirts): 二枚
counter for small animals: 1匹 (reads いっぴき・にひき・さんびき)
counter for long things (bottles, pens, trees, films): 4本 (いっぽん・にほん・さんぼん)
years of age: 27歳 (also written 才)
counter for days / day of the month: 3日, 数日
ordinals: 2番目 'the second', 十字目 'the tenth one'
time span + 後: after (2時間後 'two hours later', 12日後)
counter for times / occasions: 3回
counter for machines and vehicles: 5台
counter for books / volumes: 2冊
floors of a building: 3階
counter for shots / hits: 2発
rank / place: 1位 'first place'
school year: 3年生 'third-year'
counter for episodes of a show: 第1話
polite prefix on a noun: お for native words (お茶, お客), ご for Sino-Japanese (ご家族) — softens or honours
note: お〜する / お〜になる / お〜ください are longer and win

gloss: colloquial intensifier prefix 'super-, ultra-' (超うまい, 超大事)
第 + number: ordinal 'the Nth' (第1話, 第三者)
約 + number: approximately (約300人)
negating prefixes on Sino-Japanese words: 不 un-, 非 non-, 無 -less, 未 not-yet (when the tokenizer splits them)
全 + noun: all, every, entire (全世界, 全員)
大 + noun: big-, great-, major- (大成功, 大事故)
crude intensifier prefixes: ど (ど真ん中, どでかい), クソ (クソ野郎, クソ暑い)
old-man / western copula standing in for だ: なんでじゃ = なんでだ, 〜のじゃ = 〜んだ
older spoken variant of 〜かもしれない: 'it might well be'
'far too little of it / way too un-': the negative さ stacked on すぎる (元気がなさすぎる, つまらなさすぎる)
ろくな + noun + negative: 'no decent … at all' (ろくな奴がいない)
note: the negative is unbounded; the adverbial ろくな is the unit

gloss: literary だろう: 'it surely is / will be' (そうであろう)
archaic かもしれない: 'it may just be that…' — samurai / sage register
'it is no exaggeration to say that…' — the set formula for a big claim
end up stuck with an unwanted outcome you brought on yourself (払う羽目になった)
literary 'without doing…' (知らずして, 戦わずして)
old negative copula 'not X (but…)' / 'no ordinary…': ただならぬ, 他ならぬ
noun + じみた: bordering on, with a whiff of (狂気じみた, 子供じみた)
Kansai 'X is the whole point': a thing is only worth anything if it does X (売れてなんぼ)
number + 秒 seconds; number + 度 times / degrees (3度目 'the third time')
